notes.title: V3.1 New map: Desert Island and new plants
notes.content:
[h2]New Map: Desert Island, desert plants and navigation map[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34324870/ae033ef5e4dd934b0a43397633cb85b5edfdc1e4.jpg[/img]
You need to find an oasis in the vast desert.  When you walk out of the center of the desert, you can find some coconut trees on the coast, but there are few tree resources and animals. It rarely rains, and there are random bad sandstorms. You need to work hard to develop agriculture, collect more water, plant more trees, and build your own oasis home. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34324870/b011555147505a896bc32d7c85204209349e80c6.jpg[/img]
Note: Camels on the current desert  map cannot be attacked or ridden. Camel taming and riding functions will be updated next time. Press M to open the navigation map. Because the map is a screenshot, Players' positions on the map are not accurate

[h2]New features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added v3 sleeping function. When you are near a bed or shelter, press L to sleep when you see the prompt. The sleeping montage animation will play and you can see the stars and the moon fleeting. After 10 seconds, you will go from night to sunrise
[*] Improved the planting and harvesting system. You can get a variety of resources from the trees or crops, For example, coconut trees used to only harvest coconuts, but now you can also harvest wood and fiber. Green plants and crops can also get some fiber. Note: Due to the change in data structure, some old planting data may have some problems. Please plant new plants to harvest. v1 is not affected
[*] Bamboo planting no longer requires seeds and can be planted directly. Banana roots can be purchased from NPC survivor and can be used for planting. When you can't find banana trees in the desert map, you can buy banana roots to plant banana trees
[*] Added the function of destroying horses. When you get close to a horse and see the prompt, press K to destroy the tamed horse. Note that if there are several horses together, they may all be destroyed. Try to spread them out.
[/list]

[h2]Some fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the wrong item when recycling Wooden House2 with a hammer
[*] Improved the fence size to be more suitable for placing on the foundation or ceiling,
[*] Fixed the problem that simple shelters and fences are not easy to place on uneven ground
[*] Added LOD optimization for the trader NPC skeleton mesh
[*] Shortened the respawn time of some trees to 1 hour
[*]Fixed dogs falling through floors or foundations
[*] Adjusted the volume of footsteps
[*] Main menu UI improvements
[/list]
[b]Some tips:[/b]
[list]
[*] Note on buying a dog: If you put the dog on the ground without naming it, it will not be saved

[*]
[/list]

[h3]Tips for taming animals:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Taming most herbivores requires carrots, taming most carnivores requires raw meat, taming other animals such as wild boars requires watermelon, and elephants require bananas. Please plant carrots, watermelons and bananas, or collect bananas in the wild and hunt to get more raw meat to tame animals.
[*] Press N to switch to select your pet. Switch to its name and press X to ride or uncontrol the pet.
[*] But after pressing 0 to release the target animal, other animals will refresh once. Other commands are group commands used to command all pets.
[*] The maximum number of tamed animals is 15. After the maximum number is reached, the taming prompt will no longer be displayed for the animals that are hunted. You can follow the command to release the pets you do not want, and you can tame new animals only after entering the game again.
[*] If the pet command UI blocks other UI, you can press Z to cancel summoning the pet and turn off pet mode to hide the command UI.
[*] Note: Known problems need to be solved: after the player dies, the animal will no longer be commanded. Re-enter the game to restore the command function. After the pet dies, the player is still on the pet. Press X to release the control of the pet.
[/olist]
[list]
[*] [h3]Added wild horses to all maps, where they are randomly distributed across the map. In addition to buying horses from NPC, you can also tame wild horses. You need to plant 50 carrots to tame a horse. The horse cannot be harmed. You can tame it when you get close and see the prompt.[/h3]

notes.title: v2.0 Brand New version, Biggest Update Ever
notes.content:
v2.0 is a brand new version that supports multiplayer mode, new map, realistic island landscape and plants, new build system, crafting system, planting system,  new UI design, which is equivalent to redevelop a brand new game, and V1.0 is still available for you to choose, and the old archives will not be affected. You can choose to switch between different versions to play. Due to a lot of work. This is the biggest update since the game was released and took a lot of work and testing, This is why it took so long for the update to be released
[h1]About V2:[/h1]
New maps: brand new and more realistic vegetation and new landscapes, dense and dangerous tropical jungles, realistic coconut trees and nearly 60 kinds of various tropical plants, natural wind, 4K textures and high quality materials. A lot of optimizations, if you have a high-performance graphics card, you can easily get a high frame rate of 120fps at a resolution of 1080p, even in a jungle with dense vegetation, you can get a high frame rate of nearly 100FPS, please turn on vertical sync to reduce GPU consumption
[h2]New Build system:[/h2]
More abundant and free building modules can be built, and buildings with more complex structures can be built. New triangular walls and foundations, you can upgrade wooden walls, stone walls and iron walls, and can make decorations hanging on the walls such as lamps. The door lock function can be set with a password in multiplayer mode to prevent others from intruding. You can make C4 or bomb to blow up the building, and you will see the real physical fragmentation effect. Decorations such as carpets and wall paintings will be updated in the future.
[h2] NPC trading system:[/h2]
You can find a survivor NPC on the initial island, you can sell wood, ore and other resources to him to get gold coins, and then buy some useful items from him. Accumulating coins is a lot of fun.
[h2]New weapons: [/h2]
several new firearms and throwable explosives, etc.
[h2]Dynamic weather:[/h2]
3D cloud sky, day and night cycle system, rainy and sunny and cloudy weather, ground and plant puddles wet effect, rain water creates puddles on the ground, and will dry up slowly after the weather is sunny, characters walk in puddles to produce ripples and splashes .
[h2]Multi-archive management:[/h2]
You can customize the archive name and select the archive to load and overwrite, delete the archive
[h2]Multiplayer mode:[/h2]
When you enter the game in multiplayer mode, other steam players can see your server and join the game. Your nickname is the server name. Note that due to engine coding problems,  some languages like chinese  nickname is displayed as garbled characters, while the English name or numbers can be can display normal.  Note: In the current multiplayer mode, the character customization multiplayer replicate function is not perfect and only shows your own customized appearance. Due to the complexity of the character customization system and the need to upload steam to test the multiplayer mode, these functions will be improved and updated in the future. In addition, the custom server name, password protection and other functions of the multiplayer mode will be improved in the future, please wait patiently for the update.
[h3] Is v1 still playable? [/h3]
All the content of V1 is kept in V2, which will not affect your old archives. If you are more used to v1, you can still play the content of v1 as before. And v2 will be a major version for future updates.
[h3] Why release v2? [/h3]
Since v1 is specially designed for single-player mode, the system design has certain limitations and flaws, which lead to slow progress in the update work, such as flaws in the data structure, resulting in having to add data multiple times for each tool, in order not to damage the overall project and archive, so features cannot be modified on a large scale.
For further development of the future, a new version of V2 is launched. V2 is equivalent to the redevelopment of most of the core content, compatible with single-player and multi-player modes.
[h3] More new content will be updated continuously, there will be new maps with more types of landforms, more types of animals, etc.,  Merry Christmas! Best regards [/h3]
